audit.db:migrate:owners:internal: Native Drizzle reads catalogs and its own journals before applying pending migrations. Core and Party additionally validate pinned snapshots and exact journal equivalence; neither reads mutable application rows once converged.
audit.contactsPreparation: prepareContactsMigration reads only journal existence. A successful contacts/fresh result is stable; legacy is renamed once; ambiguous fails closed.
audit.db:bootstrap-runtime-role: Must run even on the light path: grantTrustAuthority reconciles mutable trust.gateway_audience_roles rows. Catalog hashing intentionally excludes those rows and password verifiers. Login authentication is checked independently.
audit.db:portal-auth:migrate: Native Drizzle uses an independent journal. Its role bootstrap only reconciles catalogs and its verifier reads catalogs. The optional realm's database and both credentials are fingerprinted when configured.
audit.db:verify: Read-only owner assertions still run on the light path, including mutable trust mapping validation. Failed verification cannot yield a preparation record.
